elaine: Quick follow-up on the KV eviction incidentneed owners for tests and timelines.

mira: Root cause recap: cold KV evictions + route fallback caused elevated p95 and some failures. Postmortem draft needs specific test items.

toni: I'll own a small regression harness that simulates cache hit/miss and router up/down cycles. CI target: `ci/regress/kv-routing`. ETA 6d.

ash: I'll curate a prompt pack from the incident logs (examples that triggered missing tokens/hallucinations). Will add labels and expected substrings. ETA 10d.

ryan: Perf will add a KV-miss-heavy k6 scenario and record p50/p95/p99. Include burst pattern (12k->3k over 8m). ETA 7d.

samir: I'll draft the chaos drill playbook: tabletop first, then controlled live drill. Doc ETA 4d.

elaine: Acceptance criteria to add to postmortem: prompt regression >=99% pass, p95 token latency <220ms on baseline for KV-miss profile, deterministic reproduction in CI for harness.

mira: Also add metric alerts for prefix eviction rate and router heartbeat within 30s.

toni: Will open GH issue `regress/kv-routing-2026` and link PR.

ash: Prompt CSV example: `2026-03-23-01,"Explain the policy update","policy,effective"`. Will attach log ids.

ryan: k6 sketch:
```js
export default function(){ http.post('/v1/generate', payload); sleep(0.02); }
```
I'll post perf graphs with the PR.

devops-bot: Reminder: tabletop scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.

elaine: Please drop issue/PR links here when ready. I'll update the remediation board and schedule a check-in next week.

mira: Adding acceptance criteria to postmortem now.

toni: Issue + initial PR incoming.

ash: Prompt pack upload planned for Tue EoD.

ryan: Perf PR next Tue.

elaine: Closing thread for now, will repost updates in #eng-ml. :white_check_mark:
